content.comment_body: My [product_name] was running a web page without any issues. After updating the webpage last week, it’s now inaccessible. HTTP access still works, but switching to HTTPS results in 'connection reset' errors, despite having operated smoothly over HTTPS for months before. Re-uploading an older, functioning webpage version doesn't resolve this, and toggling between HTTP and HTTPS continues to show the same problem. How can I restore stable HTTPS access?

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes loss of secure (HTTPS) access to a custom web page hosted on their [product_name] device following a webpage update. Previous troubleshooting steps, including reverting to an older page and toggling connection settings, failed to resolve persistent 'connection reset' errors. The issue points toward a disruption of previously reliable HTTPS connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects secure HTTPS access to work reliably on their device, regardless of webpage updates, and wants to be able to resolve HTTPS connectivity problems efficiently.
